svg.title: Reliability and Safety: Plan for Being Wrong
svg.desc: Before launch, evaluate the app with expected, edge-case and adversarial prompts against a definition of what wrong or unsafe means. In production, a user prompt passes through guardrails, content filters that check prompts and outputs for harmful content. The model reply is probabilistic and can be confidently wrong. If confidence is above the threshold, answer the user; if not, or the case is risky, route it to a person. Keep monitoring in production and re-evaluate after changes.
svg.text: Reliability and Safety: Plan for Being Wrong
Test before launch, filter at runtime, and send low-confidence answers to a person.
Expected, edge-case and adversarial prompts, against a clear definition of "wrong"
